cards.description: Runs a command with its arguments on the Darwin machine.

cwd.description: Current working directory, leave empty in most cases

cards.name: run_command
usage_rules: Provide the command and any arguments as a single string in the required `command` field.
Optionally set `cwd` to the working directory; leave it empty to use the default working directory.

cards.description: Runs a script on the Darwin machine by piping it to an interpreter's standard input.

cwd.description: Current working directory, leave empty in most cases

interpreter.description: Command with arguments. Script will be piped to stdin. Examples: bash, fish, zsh, python, or: bash --norc

cards.name: run_script
usage_rules: Provide the script in the required `script` field.
Optionally set `interpreter` to the command and arguments for the interpreter, such as `bash`, `python`, or `bash --norc`.
Optionally set `cwd` to the working directory; leave it empty to use the default working directory.

cards.description: 获取指定时区的详细时间信息，包括年、月、日、时、分、秒等。

hour12.description: 是否使用 12 小时制格式化时区时间。默认为 false

includeTimestamp.description: 是否在结果中包含毫秒级时间戳。默认为 false

locale.description: 用于本地化星期显示的区域设置。默认为 zh-CN

timezone.description: 时区（例如：Asia/Shanghai, UTC）。默认为系统时区

cards.name: get_time_info
usage_rules: 所有参数均为可选。
可通过 timezone 指定时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai 或 UTC；未指定时使用系统时区。
hour12 控制是否使用 12 小时制，默认为 false。
locale 指定星期显示使用的区域设置，默认为 zh-CN。
includeTimestamp 控制结果是否包含毫秒级时间戳，默认为 false。

cards.description: 将指定时间从源时区转换到目标时区，并可选择输出格式及附加时区信息。

compare_with_utc.description: 是否同时显示 UTC 时间以便对比。默认为 false

format.description: 输出格式：'iso'（ISO 8601）、'locale'（本地格式）、'timestamp'（时间戳）。默认为 'iso'

from_timezone.description: 源时区（例如：Asia/Shanghai, UTC, America/New_York）。如果未提供，使用系统时区

include_dst_info.description: 是否包含夏令时（DST）信息。默认为 false

include_offset.description: 是否包含 UTC 偏移信息（如 +08:00）。默认为 false

include_time_difference.description: 是否包含源时区和目标时区之间的时间差（以小时为单位）。默认为 false

include_timezone_abbr.description: 是否包含时区缩写（如 CST, EST, JST）。默认为 false

output_locale.description: 用于 'locale' 格式的区域设置（如 'en-US', 'ja-JP'）。默认为 'zh-CN'

time.description: 要转换的时间。支持 ISO 8601 格式（如 '2024-03-15T10:30:00'）或时间戳（毫秒）。如果未提供，使用当前时间

to_timezone.description: 目标时区（例如：Asia/Tokyo, Europe/London）。必填参数

cards.name: convert_timezone
usage_rules: to_timezone 是必填参数；使用 IANA 时区名称指定目标时区，例如 Asia/Tokyo 或 Europe/London。
from_timezone 可指定源时区；未提供时使用系统时区。
time 可提供 ISO 8601 时间或毫秒级时间戳；未提供时使用当前时间。
format 可选 iso、locale 或 timestamp，默认为 iso。
仅当 format 为 locale 时，output_locale 用于指定区域设置，默认为 zh-CN。
compare_with_utc、include_dst_info、include_offset、include_time_difference 和 include_timezone_abbr 均为可选布尔参数，默认均为 false，分别控制是否显示 UTC 对照、夏令时信息、UTC 偏移、时区间小时差和时区缩写。

cards.description: 获取当前日期和时间，可指定时区及结果格式。

format.description: 时间格式：'iso'（ISO 8601）、'locale'（本地格式）、'timestamp'（时间戳）。默认为 'iso'

timezone.description: 时区（例如：Asia/Shanghai, UTC, America/New_York）。默认为系统时区

cards.name: get_current_time
usage_rules: 所有参数均为可选。
timezone 可指定时区，例如 Asia/Shanghai、UTC 或 America/New_York；未指定时使用系统时区。
format 可选 iso、locale 或 timestamp，默认为 iso。

cards.description: Execute a custom sequence of MCP tool calls. Each step specifies a name, the MCP server, the tool, and optionally parameters and dependencies on other named steps.
cards.name: run_sequence
usage_rules: Provide the required steps array; each step must include name, mcp, and tool.
Use params to supply parameters to a step's tool when needed.
Use dependsOn to list names of steps that this step depends on; omit it when there are no dependencies.

cards.description: Inspect a workflow without executing it. The inspection can include its steps, configuration, dependencies, and—when requested—parameter schemas.

focus.description: Alternatively, specify a focus area to inspect the auto-selected workflow

include_schemas.description: Include detailed parameter schemas for each step (optional, defaults to false)

validate_dependencies.description: Validate dependency graph for cycles and missing references (optional, defaults to true)

cards.name: inspect_workflow
usage_rules: All inputs are optional. Specify workflow to inspect a named workflow, or focus to inspect the workflow selected for that focus area.
focus must be security, quality, performance, or comprehensive.
Set include_schemas to true to request detailed parameter schemas; it defaults to false.
Set validate_dependencies to false to skip dependency checks; it defaults to true.

cards.description: List available pre-built workflows and their descriptions.
cards.name: list_workflows
usage_rules: No parameters are required or accepted.

cards.description: Run an intelligent code-analysis workflow, selecting by focus or using a supported explicit workflow. Can incorporate the user's original request as context and configure paths, result format, and severity threshold.

excludePaths.description: Glob patterns or paths to exclude from analysis (optional, e.g. ["node_modules", "dist"])

focus.description: Focus area for smart workflow selection (optional)

output_format.description: Response structure: full (default), summary, or minimal (optional)

prompt.description: Original user request for workflow context (optional)

severity_threshold.description: Minimum severity level to include in results (optional, defaults to low)

cards.name: run_workflow
usage_rules: Use this tool for requests to review, check, or analyze code.
For an ambiguous request, omit workflow and focus so the tool can seek clarification. For a specific focus, set focus to security, quality, performance, or comprehensive.
To select a direct workflow, set workflow to pre-commit, pre-merge, or quality-audit.
Include prompt to preserve the user's original request as context, especially for richer requests.
projectPath is optional and defaults to the current working directory; excludePaths optionally lists paths or glob patterns to omit.
output_format may be full, summary, or minimal. severity_threshold may be low, medium, high, or critical; it defaults to low.

cards.description: Fetches the full content and metadata for one LeetCode community solution, including article text, author details, and related navigation links.

topicId.description: The unique topic ID of the solution to retrieve. This ID can be obtained from the 'topicId' field in the response of the 'list_problem_solutions' tool. Format is typically a string of numbers and letters that uniquely identifies the solution in LeetCode's database.

cards.name: get_problem_solution
usage_rules: Provide the solution's topicId as a string; obtain it from a result returned by list_problem_solutions.
This retrieves a specific solution, not a problem by its slug.

cards.description: Retrieves a LeetCode user's contest ranking information, including ranking, contest participation, and performance metrics.

attended.description: Whether to include only the contests the user has participated in (true) or all contests (false); defaults to true

username.description: LeetCode username to retrieve contest ranking information for

cards.name: get_user_contest_ranking
usage_rules: username is required.
attended is optional and defaults to true: true limits results to contests the user attended; false requests all contests.

cards.description: Retrieves a user's recent accepted submissions on LeetCode Global.

limit.description: Maximum number of accepted submissions to return (optional, defaults to server-defined limit)

username.description: LeetCode username to retrieve recent accepted submissions for

cards.name: get_recent_ac_submissions
usage_rules: username is required.
limit is optional and numeric; it controls the maximum number of accepted submissions returned.

cards.description: Lists community solutions for a LeetCode problem, returning solution metadata such as topicId. Use get_problem_solution to retrieve a listed solution's full content.

limit.description: Maximum number of solutions to return per request. Used for pagination and controlling response size. Default is 20 if not specified. Must be a positive integer.

orderBy.description: Sorting criteria for the returned solutions. 'DEFAULT' sorts by LeetCode's default algorithm (typically a combination of recency and popularity), 'MOST_VOTES' sorts by the number of upvotes (highest first), and 'MOST_RECENT' sorts by publication date (newest first).

questionSlug.description: The URL slug/identifier of the problem to retrieve solutions for (e.g., 'two-sum', 'add-two-numbers'). This is the same string that appears in the LeetCode problem URL after '/problems/'

skip.description: Number of solutions to skip before starting to collect results. Used in conjunction with 'limit' for implementing pagination. Default is 0 if not specified. Must be a non-negative integer.

tagSlugs.description: Array of tag identifiers to filter solutions by programming languages (e.g., 'python', 'java') or problem algorithm/data-structure tags (e.g., 'dynamic-programming', 'recursion'). Only solutions tagged with at least one of the specified tags will be returned.

userInput.description: Search term to filter solutions by title, content, or author name. Case insensitive. Useful for finding specific approaches or algorithms mentioned in solutions.

cards.name: list_problem_solutions
usage_rules: questionSlug is required and should be the problem's URL slug, such as two-sum.
Use topicId values from the results with get_problem_solution to fetch full solution content.
limit and skip are numeric pagination controls; limit is intended to be positive and skip non-negative.
tagSlugs optionally filters by one or more language or topic tag slugs; userInput optionally searches solution titles, content, or author names.
orderBy accepts HOT, MOST_VOTES, or the schema's literal value " MOST_RECENT" (including its leading space).

cards.description: Retrieves a user's recent LeetCode Global submissions, including accepted and failed submissions with metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of submissions to return (optional, defaults to server-defined limit)

username.description: LeetCode username to retrieve recent submissions for

cards.name: get_recent_submissions
usage_rules: username is required.
limit is optional and numeric; it controls the maximum number of recent submissions returned.

cards.description: Searches LeetCode problems using filters such as category, difficulty, tags, status, premium availability, and keywords, with pagination and sorting options.

category.description: Problem category filter (e.g., 'algorithms', 'database', 'shell') to narrow down the problem domain

difficulty.description: Problem difficulty level filter to show only problems of a specific difficulty

limit.description: Maximum number of problems to return in a single request (for pagination)

offset.description: Number of problems to skip (for pagination)

orderBy.description: Sort order for returned problems - by problem ID (default), difficulty level, acceptance rate, or frequency in interviews

premiumOnly.description: When true, returns only premium problems; when false, returns only free problems; when undefined, returns all problems regardless of premium status

searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search in problem titles and descriptions

status.description: Filter problems by user's completion status - SOLVED (fully completed), ATTEMPTED (tried but not solved), or NOT_STARTED (never attempted)

tags.description: List of topic tags to filter problems by (e.g., ['array', 'dynamic-programming', 'tree'])

cards.name: search_problems
usage_rules: All filters are optional. category defaults to all-code-essentials; limit defaults to 10.
Use offset and limit for pagination; both are numeric.

difficulty, status, category, and orderBy must use values allowed by the schema. premiumOnly=true selects premium problems, false selects free problems, and omitting it leaves premium status unrestricted.
tags is an array of allowed topic tag strings; searchKeywords searches problem titles and descriptions.
The schema does not require any particular filter, so an empty object is valid.

cards.description: Retrieves graduated hints for a LeetCode problem, offering guidance without returning the complete solution.

titleSlug.description: The URL slug/identifier of the problem (e.g., 'two-sum', 'add-two-numbers') to retrieve hints for

cards.name: get_problem_hints
usage_rules: titleSlug is required; provide the problem's URL slug, such as two-sum.

cards.description: Retrieves comprehensive details for a LeetCode problem, including its description, examples, constraints, and related information. It can also retrieve today's Daily Challenge.

daily.description: When set to true, retrieves today's LeetCode Daily Challenge problem instead of a specific problem by slug

titleSlug.description: The URL slug/identifier of the problem (e.g., 'two-sum', 'add-two-numbers') as it appears in the LeetCode URL. Not required when 'daily' is true

cards.name: get_problem
usage_rules: For a specific problem, provide its titleSlug, such as two-sum.
Set daily to true to retrieve today's Daily Challenge; titleSlug is not required in that case.
If daily is omitted or false, provide titleSlug to identify the problem.

cards.description: Retrieves a LeetCode user's profile information, including profile details, statistics, and solved-problem information.

username.description: LeetCode username to retrieve profile information for

cards.name: get_user_profile
usage_rules: username is required.

cards.description: Apply semantic layout to a LikeC4 view in the selected project.

projectId.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

viewId.description: View ID to apply semantic layout to

cards.name: apply-semantic-layout
usage_rules: Provide the required viewId.
Use projectId to select a project; it defaults to "default".

cards.description: Render a saved LikeC4 view as an interactive diagram in chat, with pan, zoom, and fit controls.

fullModel.description: Include the complete model instead of data scoped to this view

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

fitView.description: Fit the diagram into the canvas initially

cards.name: render-view
usage_rules: Provide the required viewId.
Use this when the user wants to see a view; use read-view when they need only its nodes and edges.
The project argument defaults to "default". Set fullModel to true to include the complete model instead of view-scoped data.
The render options can set canvas size and fitView; initialZoom, when provided, overrides fitView.

cards.description: Summarize an element's descendants breadth-first, including each descendant's depth, tags, metadata, and child and relationship counts.

elementId.description: Parent element id (FQN) whose descendants to summarize

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth of descendants to include (default: 10, max: 20)

metadataKeys.description: If provided, only include these metadata keys in the response

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: subgraph-summary
usage_rules: Provide the required elementId as a fully qualified element ID (FQN).
The project argument defaults to "default". maxDepth defaults to 10 and must be between 1 and 20.
At most 200 descendants are returned; check truncated and truncatedByDepth to see whether results were cut off.
Pass metadataKeys to limit returned metadata to those keys.
Use this instead of calling read-element separately for many descendants.

cards.description: Find elements and deployment nodes by exact tags using allOf, anyOf, and noneOf conditions combined with AND.

allOf.description: Element must have ALL these tags (AND)

anyOf.description: Element must have ANY of these tags (OR)

noneOf.description: Element must have NONE of these tags (NOT)

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: query-by-tags
usage_rules: Provide at least one non-empty tag condition: allOf, anyOf, or noneOf.
allOf requires every listed tag; anyOf requires at least one; noneOf excludes elements with any listed tag.
Tag matching is case-sensitive. Results are limited to 50.
Use query-by-tag-pattern for partial tag-name matching.
The project argument defaults to "default".

cards.description: Render an unsaved draft view from LikeC4 DSL against an existing project's real elements, for iterating before creating the view.

fullModel.description: Include the complete model instead of data scoped to this view

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: preview-view
usage_rules: Provide a single-element view definition in the form `view <id> ... { ... }`.
Use a new view ID; an existing ID is rejected. Use render-view for a saved view.
Dynamic and deployment views are unsupported and fail with a generic view-not-found error.
Custom theme and style extensions are not applied.
The project argument defaults to "default". Set fullModel to true to include the complete model instead of view-scoped data.

cards.description: List the LikeC4 projects available in the workspace.
cards.name: list-projects
usage_rules: Call with no arguments; the tool takes no input properties.
Use a listed project ID as the project argument for other tools that support project selection.

cards.description: Find direct relationships between two elements and indirect relationships through their nested elements, with relationship details, views, and source locations.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: find-relationships
usage_rules: Provide both element1 and element2 as fully qualified element IDs (FQNs).
The project argument defaults to "default".
Result order is not guaranteed.
For multi-hop relationship chains, use find-relationship-paths.

cards.description: Read an element's properties, metadata, links, children, views, incoming and outgoing relationships, deployed instances, and source location.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: read-element
usage_rules: Provide the required id as a fully qualified element ID (FQN).
The project argument defaults to "default".
For many elements, use batch-read-elements instead.

cards.description: Read a deployment node or deployed instance, including its kind, tags, metadata, links, children, views, source location, and instantiated element when applicable.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: read-deployment
usage_rules: Provide the required id as a fully qualified deployment ID (FQN).
The project argument defaults to "default".
Children are empty for a deployed instance.

cards.description: Traverse downstream dependencies from an element and return a graph of elements that consume its output directly or transitively, with node depths and outgoers.

elementId.description: Target element id (FQN) to query outgoers for

includeIndirect.description: Include indirect relationships through nested elements (default: true)

maxNodes.description: Maximum number of nodes to return (default: 200, max: 2000)

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: query-outgoers-graph
usage_rules: Provide the required elementId as a fully qualified element ID (FQN).
The project argument defaults to "default"; includeIndirect defaults to true.
maxDepth defaults to 10 and cannot exceed 50. maxNodes defaults to 200 and cannot exceed 2000; both must be positive integers.
If truncated is true, increase maxNodes or reduce maxDepth as appropriate.

cards.description: Compare two elements in the same project, reporting differences and shared values in properties, tags, metadata, and incoming and outgoing relationship counts.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: element-diff
usage_rules: Provide both required element IDs: element1Id and element2Id, as fully qualified element IDs (FQNs).
Both elements must belong to the same project.
The project argument defaults to "default".

cards.description: Find elements whose tags match a partial-name pattern, returning matching tags per element and the distinct matching tags.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: query-by-tag-pattern
usage_rules: Provide a non-empty pattern.
matchMode defaults to prefix; choose prefix, contains, or suffix. Matching is case-insensitive.
Results are limited to 50.
Use query-by-tags for exact tags with boolean conditions.
The project argument defaults to "default".

cards.description: Search elements and deployment nodes across all projects by ID/FQN, title, kind, shape, tag, or metadata key. Returns the total match count and the first 20 results.

search.description: Case-insensitive. "kind:<value>" or "shape:<value>" matches a kind or shape exactly, "meta:<key>" elements with that metadata key, "#<value>" tags containing the value; anything else matches id (FQN) or title.

cards.name: search-element
usage_rules: Provide a search string of at least 2 characters.
Search is case-insensitive.
Use kind:<value> or shape:<value> to match a kind or shape exactly.
Use meta:<key> to find elements with that metadata key, or #<value> to find tags containing that value.
Any other search string is matched against IDs (FQNs) or titles.
Use IDs from the results with read-element or other tools that accept element IDs.

cards.description: Find relationship paths from one element to another, ordered shortest first. Follows direct relationships by default; optionally includes implied relationships through nested elements. Returns at most 100 paths, or an empty list if no connection is found.

includeIndirect.description: Include indirect (implied) relationships through nested elements (default: false)

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: find-relationship-paths
usage_rules: Provide sourceId and targetId as element FQNs; they must identify different elements.
The project defaults to "default" if omitted.
maxDepth defaults to 3 and must be between 1 and 5; it limits the number of hops in a path.
Set includeIndirect to true to include implied relationships through nested elements; it defaults to false.

cards.description: Find elements and deployment nodes matching a metadata key and, optionally, a value. Returns at most 50 results.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

value.description: Metadata value to match (ignored for exists mode)

cards.name: query-by-metadata
usage_rules: The key is required; the project defaults to "default" if omitted.
matchMode defaults to exact: it compares values case-sensitively.
Use contains for a case-insensitive substring match, or exists to match any element with the key while ignoring value.
For exact or contains matching, provide value; in exists mode, value is ignored.
If a metadata value is an array, a match is returned when any array item matches.

cards.description: Read a view's structure, including its elements, deployment nodes or deployed instances, the edges between them, and source location. If the view has no title, its ID is used as the title.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: read-view
usage_rules: Provide the required viewId (the view name); project defaults to "default" if omitted.
Use render-view to show the diagram to the user.

cards.description: Read summaries for up to 50 elements in one call, including properties, metadata, children, relationship counts, views that include each element, links, and source location. IDs not found are reported in notFound rather than causing the call to fail.

ids.description: Array of element ids (FQNs) to read (max 50)

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: batch-read-elements
usage_rules: Provide 1–50 element IDs (FQNs) in ids; the project defaults to "default" if omitted.
Use this tool for summaries of multiple elements. Use read-element when you also need relationships, deployedInstances, defaultView, or project.

cards.description: Recursively traverse upstream relationships to return the elements that feed into a target, including each node's depth and incomers. Traversal stops at maxDepth or maxNodes; the result indicates whether it was truncated.

elementId.description: Target element id (FQN) to query incomers for

includeIndirect.description: Include indirect relationships through nested elements (default: true)

maxNodes.description: Maximum number of nodes to return (default: 200, max: 2000)

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: query-incomers-graph
usage_rules: Provide the target element's FQN as elementId; project defaults to "default" if omitted.
includeIndirect defaults to true and controls whether implied relationships through nested elements are included.
maxDepth defaults to 10 and must be a positive integer no greater than 50.
maxNodes defaults to 200 and must be a positive integer no greater than 2000.
If truncated is true, increase maxNodes or reduce maxDepth to adjust the traversal.

cards.description: Provide an overview of a LikeC4 project: configuration, specification kinds and tags, metadata keys, and the IDs, kinds, titles, and tags of its elements, deployment entities, and views.

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: read-project-summary
usage_rules: The project parameter is optional and defaults to "default".
Use this overview to orient yourself before reading individual elements or views.

cards.description: Run a one-step graph query around an element. Supports hierarchy queries (ancestors, descendants, siblings, children, parent) and relationship queries (incomers, outgoers); returns at most 100 results.

includeIndirect.description: For incomers/outgoers: include indirect relationships (default: true)

project.description: Project id (optional, will use "default" if not specified)

cards.name: query-graph
usage_rules: Provide elementId as an element FQN and select a required queryType from ancestors, descendants, siblings, children, parent, incomers, or outgoers.
The project defaults to "default" if omitted.
includeIndirect defaults to true and affects only incomers and outgoers, adding relationships of nested children; it is ignored for hierarchy queries.
Incomers and outgoers are single-hop queries. For recursive traversal, use query-incomers-graph or query-outgoers-graph.

cards.description: Records a synthesis of findings from multiple reasoning paths. It accepts source path identifiers, shared conclusions, evidence-strength assessments, a conflict-resolution strategy, a unified conclusion, and a confidence level. Optional fields capture disagreements, unresolved questions, and mappings from conclusion elements back to source paths.

convergencePoints.description: Key insights where multiple paths agree

evidenceWeighting.description: Assessment of evidence strength per path

openQuestions.description: Remaining uncertainties or areas needing exploration

sourcePaths.description: Array of path/chain identifiers being synthesized

synthesisId.description: Unique identifier for this synthesis session

synthesizedConclusion.description: The unified final answer or conclusion

traceability.description: Mapping of conclusion elements to source paths

cards.name: convergent-synthesis
usage_rules: Provide all required fields: synthesisId, sourcePaths, convergencePoints, evidenceWeighting, resolutionStrategy, synthesizedConclusion, and confidenceLevel.

Use evidenceWeighting as a mapping from path identifiers to strong, moderate, or weak; use a supported resolutionStrategy (evidence_based, logical_priority, contextual_fit, or consensus) and confidenceLevel (high, moderate, or low).
Represent each contradiction with a point and conflictingPaths. Use traceability to map conclusion elements to arrays of source path identifiers when useful.
Use this after exploring multiple paths or hypotheses when a consolidated result is needed; include unresolved uncertainties in openQuestions.

cards.description: Records a step within one of several parallel reasoning paths, including the path's identifier, current thought, position, status, and whether the paths are ready for synthesis. Optional fields describe related paths, convergence, or whether another path should be created.

needsNewPath.description: Whether to create a new parallel path

pathId.description: Identifier for the current reasoning path

readyForSynthesis.description: Whether ready to synthesize all paths

thought.description: Current thinking step within this path

thoughtInPath.description: Thought number within this specific path

totalPaths.description: Total number of paths being explored

cards.name: parallel-thinking
usage_rules: Provide pathId, thought, pathNumber, totalPaths, thoughtInPath, pathStatus, and readyForSynthesis on every call.
Use integers of at least 1 for pathNumber, totalPaths, and thoughtInPath. Set pathStatus to active, completed, abandoned, or merged.
Use relatedPaths to identify relevant or conflicting paths, and set convergenceDetected or needsNewPath when applicable.

Use separate path identifiers for distinct approaches and develop them independently; indicate readiness when the paths are sufficiently explored. Use convergent-synthesis to record a unified conclusion.

cards.description: Records a step in a flexible, sequential problem-solving process. A step can continue an analysis, revise an earlier step, or identify a branch; the estimated number of steps can be adjusted as work progresses.

confidenceScore.description: Confidence level in this thought's validity, ranging from 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (complete confidence)

nextThoughtNeeded.description: Whether another thought step is needed

thoughtPriority.description: Priority level of this thought indicating its importance to the overall reasoning chain

totalThoughts.description: Estimated total thoughts needed (numeric value, e.g., 5, 10)

cards.name: sequentialthinking
usage_rules: Provide thought, nextThoughtNeeded, thoughtNumber, and totalThoughts on every call; both numeric fields must be integers of at least 1.
Set nextThoughtNeeded to false only when the sequential process is complete, or true when another step is needed. Adjust totalThoughts as the estimate changes.
For a revision, set isRevision and, when applicable, identify the earlier step with revisesThought. For a branch, use branchFromThought and branchId as appropriate.

Optional fields include needsMoreThoughts, confidenceScore (0 to 1), and thoughtPriority (critical, high, medium, or low). Use this for one evolving line of analysis; use parallel-thinking to track distinct approaches.

cards.description: Export the current diagram to the file path you specify. The file extension determines the format unless you explicitly provide `format`; supported formats are Draw.io XML, PNG, and SVG.

cards.description: Creates a regional distribution map for administrative divisions within China. Use it to show regional composition or data distribution, not the locations of individual places.

The `fillColor` configuration represents the default fill color for areas without data. Lower-level administrative divisions do not need `fillColor` configuration, and their fill colors are determined by the `colors` configuration (If `dataType` is "number", only one base color (warm color) is needed in the list to calculate the continuous data mapping color band; if `dataType` is "enum", the number of color values in the list is equal to the number of enumeration values (contrast colors)). It cannot be a specific place name or a vague name, such as "其它".

usage_rules: Provide a title of no more than 16 characters and a data object with a specific Chinese administrative-region name within China; valid region levels are country, province, city, district, or county.

Optionally set `title`; it defaults to an empty string. Set `width` and `height` optionally; they default to 600 and 400.
Optionally set `theme` to `default`, `academy`, or `dark`; it defaults to `default`.
Optionally provide `style` with a string `backgroundColor`, an array of string colors in `palette`, and/or `texture` set to `default` or `rough`.

cards.description: Retrieve metadata for a file or directory within allowed directories, including size, creation and modification times, permissions, and type. Text files also report line count, last-line index, and append position; Excel files report sheet names and dimensions.
cards.name: get_file_info
usage_rules: Provide the required path; absolute paths are most reliable.
Use only paths within allowed directories. Paths are normalized for slash direction; relative and tilde paths depend on the environment.

cards.description: Read output from a running process identified by PID, with line-based pagination and status detection. Offset zero reads new output since the previous read and can wait for output; positive offsets read from an absolute line position, and negative offsets read from the end. Output is bounded by the configured file-read line limit.
cards.name: read_process_output
usage_rules: Provide the required PID. Use offset and length to paginate; length is a maximum line count, subject to the configured output limit.
Use offset 0 for new output, a positive offset for an absolute position, or a negative offset to read from the end.
timeout_ms controls waiting for new output at offset 0. Process completion, prompts, or timeouts may be reported; a timeout does not necessarily mean the process has stopped.
Use verbose_timing only when timing details are useful.

cards.description: Set a configuration value by key. Configuration affects later file and command behavior and includes settings such as blockedCommands, defaultShell, allowedDirectories, fileReadLineLimit, fileWriteLineLimit, and telemetryEnabled.
cards.name: set_config_value
usage_rules: Provide the required key and value. The value must be a string, number, boolean, string array, or null; origin, if supplied, must be ui or llm.
Treat configuration changes as consequential and avoid letting untrusted file or command content determine them.
Setting allowedDirectories to an empty array grants access to the entire filesystem, regardless of operating system; do not do this unless explicitly intended and authorized.

cards.description: Read content from an authorized local file or, when isUrl is true, from a URL. Supports line-based pagination for text, page pagination for PDFs, structured data for Excel files, viewable base64 content for supported images, and outline or raw XML views for DOCX files.
cards.name: read_file
usage_rules: Provide the required path. Local filesystem reads are restricted to allowed directories; absolute paths are most reliable. Set isUrl to true to fetch a URL; URL content is read in full and ignores offset and length.

For text, offset is a zero-based line position; negative offsets read from the end. length limits results for nonnegative offsets and is ignored for negative offsets. The default length is 1000 lines.
For Excel files, use sheet as a sheet name or zero-based index expressed as a string, and range in FROM:TO form when needed; offset and length can paginate rows.
For PDFs, offset and length paginate pages. For DOCX, omitting offset and length returns the text-bearing outline; a nonzero offset requests paginated raw XML, while offset 0 returns the outline.
Use options only when format-specific options are needed.

cards.description: Start a background search that returns progressively available results. Search filenames with searchType files, or search file contents with searchType content. The query is interpreted as a regular expression by default, or as an exact literal string when literalSearch is true.
cards.name: start_search
usage_rules: Provide the required search path and pattern. Use absolute paths when possible; search is limited to accessible directories.
Choose files for filename patterns and content for text/code queries. If the request could mean either, run both search types.
Use literalSearch for exact strings containing regex metacharacters. ignoreCase defaults to true; filePattern can constrain matching to selected file types.

Use includeHidden, contextLines, maxResults, and timeout_ms to adjust scope or output as needed. earlyTermination can stop a file search after an exact filename match; its default behavior differs for file and content searches.
The search runs in the background. Use its returned session ID to retrieve results or stop it; list_searches can show active searches.

cards.description: List active background searches, showing their IDs, search types, patterns, statuses, and runtimes.
cards.name: list_searches
usage_rules: Call with no arguments to inspect and manage concurrent searches.
Use a listed search ID with the search-result retrieval or stop operation as appropriate.

cards.description: Write content to a file, replacing it by default or appending when mode is append. Supports text content and JSON-formatted two-dimensional arrays or named-sheet objects for Excel files. Can create DOCX files, converting Markdown headings to styled paragraphs.
cards.name: write_file
usage_rules: Provide the required path and string content. Files must be within allowed directories; absolute paths are most reliable.
The default mode rewrite replaces file contents; choose append to add content to the end.

For longer output, split into multiple calls, using rewrite for the first chunk and append for subsequent chunks. Calls of roughly 25–30 lines are suggested to reduce latency; very long writes may produce performance notes.
For Excel files, supply content as a JSON 2D array or an object mapping sheet names to 2D arrays. Use the dedicated PDF tool for PDF creation; use edit_block for editing existing DOCX content.

cards.description: Forcefully terminate a running process identified by PID.
cards.name: kill_process
usage_rules: Provide the required PID and verify it refers to the intended process before calling.
Use with caution: termination is forceful and may interrupt work or cause data loss.

cards.description: List active terminal sessions with their process IDs, blocked status, and runtime. A blocked session may be waiting for input, as is common for REPLs.
cards.name: list_sessions
usage_rules: Call with no arguments to inspect active terminal sessions.
Use the reported PID to read process output or interact with a session; a blocked status can indicate that a REPL is ready for input.

cards.description: Gracefully stop an active background search. Stopped searches remain available for reading final results until automatically cleaned up after five minutes.
cards.name: stop_search
usage_rules: Provide the required sessionId for the search to stop.
Use this when results are sufficient or a search is taking too long; stopping a search does not immediately remove its final results.

cards.description: Create a PDF from Markdown content or modify an existing PDF using page insertion and deletion operations. Supports Markdown, basic formatting, HTML/CSS, inline SVG, images, and explicit page breaks.
cards.name: write_pdf
usage_rules: Provide the required path and content. Creating a PDF requires an outputPath with a new filename; modifications to an existing PDF preserve the original and require a different outputPath.
For creation, content is a Markdown string. For modification, content is an array of insert and/or delete operations; page indexes are zero-based.
A delete operation requires pageIndexes. An insert operation requires pageIndex and may include Markdown or a sourcePdfPath.
Only use paths within allowed directories. Absolute paths are most reliable.

cards.description: Retrieve tool-usage statistics, including summary counts, success and failure rates, and performance metrics.
cards.name: get_usage_stats
usage_rules: Call with no arguments when usage diagnostics or aggregate performance information are needed.

cards.description: Opens the Desktop Commander feedback form in a browser. The form collects survey responses; this tool neither accepts nor pre-fills them. It automatically includes basic usage metadata: command count, days using Desktop Commander, platform, and client ID.
cards.name: give_feedback_to_desktop_commander
usage_rules: Call with an empty object; there are no input parameters.
Use this to direct someone to provide feedback, not to submit feedback on their behalf.

cards.description: Returns recent local tool-call history, including arguments and outputs, in chronological order. History is read from the local tool-history.jsonl file; it excludes calls to this tool and track_ui_event. The history retains up to 1,000 calls in memory, trims older on-disk history, and replaces stored outputs over 4 KiB with an omission marker.
cards.name: get_recent_tool_calls
usage_rules: Optionally provide maxResults (1–1,000; default 50), since (a date-time string), and/or toolName to limit the returned history.
Use it to recover recent work context or inspect tool-call sequences; it is not a complete record of every call if entries have been trimmed or outputs omitted.

cards.description: Starts a terminal process on the authorized device and reports detected process state and available output. Supports one-shot shell commands, interactive REPLs, scripts, and long-running work. This server runs on macOS with /bin/zsh as its default shell. Detection can identify prompts, waiting-for-input states, completion, and timeouts; verbose timing can provide exit reason, duration, time to first output, and an output-event timeline.
cards.name: start_process
usage_rules: Provide both required parameters: command and timeout_ms. Optionally set shell to select a shell and verbose_timing to request timing details; origin, if supplied, must be ui or llm.

Use interact_with_process with the returned process ID to continue an interactive or still-running process, read_process_output for available output as applicable, or force_terminate to end a session.
Prefer absolute paths for reliable path resolution. On macOS, Python may be python3; Homebrew is common, GNU utilities may have alternate names, and SIP can restrict operations.

cards.description: Lists running processes with process information including PID, command name, CPU usage, and memory usage.
cards.name: list_processes
usage_rules: Call with an empty object; there are no input parameters.
Use the reported PID when addressing a particular process with a process-control tool.

cards.description: Sends text or a command to an existing terminal or REPL process and returns newly available output and status indicators. It can wait for a recognized prompt, detect errors or completion, and clean common REPL prompt text from returned output.
cards.name: interact_with_process
usage_rules: Provide the required pid (from start_process) and input. Optionally set timeout_ms, wait_for_prompt, and verbose_timing; the documented defaults are 8,000 ms, true, and false, respectively.
Use this for follow-up input to an interactive session or a running command. Set wait_for_prompt to control whether it waits for a recognized prompt before returning.
Use verbose_timing when investigating timing; it adds exit reason, duration, time to first output, and output-event timeline.

cards.description: Creates a directory, including any necessary nested directories, or ensures that the requested directory exists. Access is limited to allowed directories.
cards.name: create_directory
usage_rules: Provide the required path. Prefer an absolute path for reliable resolution; relative paths depend on the current working directory, and tilde paths may not resolve in every context.
Only create directories within the server's allowed directories.

cards.description: Reads a range of results from an active search session and returns that range with search status. Supports offset-based pagination for searches started with start_search.
cards.name: get_more_search_results
usage_rules: Provide the required sessionId for an active search.
offset defaults to 0 and is zero-based. With a nonnegative offset, length (default 100, minimum 1) selects the maximum number of results to return.
A negative offset reads that many results from the end; length is ignored in this tail mode.

cards.description: Returns a structured listing of files and directories at a path, with [FILE] and [DIR] markers and paths relative to the listed root. It can recursively list to a chosen depth. The top-level directory shows all items; nested directories are limited to 100 items each, with a warning when additional items are hidden. Inaccessible and nonexistent paths are marked [DENIED] and [NOT_FOUND]. Access is limited to allowed directories.
cards.name: list_directory
usage_rules: Provide the required path. depth defaults to 2: depth 1 lists direct contents, depth 2 includes one nested level, and larger values include more levels. Optionally set origin to ui or llm.
Prefer an absolute path for reliable resolution; relative paths depend on the current working directory, and tilde paths may not resolve in every context.
Expect nested directories with more than 100 items to be truncated in the listing.

cards.description: Force-terminates a running terminal session.
cards.name: force_terminate
usage_rules: Provide the required pid of the terminal session to terminate.
Use only when the session should be stopped; this forcefully ends it.

cards.description: Reads multiple files in one operation and returns each file's contents with its path as a reference. Text files are returned as text; recognized PNG, JPEG, GIF, and WebP images are rendered as viewable content. An individual file read failure does not prevent attempts to read the other files. Access is limited to allowed directories.
cards.name: read_multiple_files
usage_rules: Provide the required paths array; each entry is a file path to read.
Prefer absolute paths for reliable resolution. Relative paths depend on the current working directory, and tilde paths may not resolve in every context.
A failure on one path does not stop the operation from attempting the remaining paths.

cards.description: Applies focused edits to a file. For text files, it finds old_string and replaces it with new_string; for DOCX files, it performs find/replace on the pretty-printed XML and repacks the document; for Excel files, it updates a specified range with supplied content. Text and DOCX edits replace one occurrence by default, or an exact requested number of occurrences. Access and write-size limits apply.
cards.name: edit_block
usage_rules: Provide the required file_path. For text and DOCX edits, supply old_string and new_string; expected_replacements defaults to 1. When replacing one occurrence, include enough exact surrounding context to uniquely identify it. For multiple distinct edits, make separate calls.
For DOCX, use XML fragments as shown by read_file output; the operation can also search headers and footers if the match is not in the document body.
For Excel files (.xlsx, .xls, .xlsm), provide range in SheetName!A1:C10 format and content as a two-dimensional array; do not use text find/replace parameters for range updates.

Optionally provide origin (ui or llm) and options. Verify the target text or range before editing; the tool may show a character-level diff for a close but non-exact match and may warn when the configured file-write line limit is exceeded.
Prefer absolute paths for reliable resolution; relative paths depend on the current working directory, and tilde paths may not resolve in every context.

cards.description: Returns the complete Desktop Commander server configuration as JSON, including blocked commands, default shell, allowed directories, file read/write line limits, telemetry setting, connected-client information and history, version, and system information.
cards.name: get_config
usage_rules: Call with an empty object or optionally provide origin as ui or llm.
Use the returned configuration to check server settings and access boundaries; do not assume paths outside allowedDirectories are accessible.

cards.description: Move a file or directory to a destination, or rename it by specifying a new destination. Both the source and destination must be within allowed directories.
cards.name: move_file
usage_rules: Provide both required string arguments: source and destination.
Use absolute paths when possible; relative paths depend on the current working directory, and tilde paths (~/...) may not resolve in every context.
Paths are normalized regardless of slash direction.

cards.description: 根据出生时间和性别获取八字信息。时间可用公历或农历表示。

eightCharProviderSect.description: 早晚子时配置。传1表示23:00-23:59日干支为明天，传2表示23:00-23:59日干支为当天。

gender.description: 传0表示女性，传1表示男性。

lunarDatetime.description: 农历时间。例如农历2000年5月初五中午12点整表示为：`2000-5-5 12:00:00`。

cards.name: getBaziDetail
usage_rules: gender 必填：0 表示女性，1 表示男性。
solarDatetime 与 lunarDatetime 必须且只能提供一个；不要同时提供或都省略。
solarDatetime 使用带时区的 ISO 公历时间，例如 2008-03-01T13:00:00+08:00。
lunarDatetime 使用农历日期和时间格式，例如 2000-5-5 12:00:00。
eightCharProviderSect 可选：1 表示 23:00–23:59 的日干支按次日计算，2 表示按当天计算；默认值为 2。

cards.description: 根据指定的八字查找对应的公历时间列表，时间以 YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss 格式返回。

bazi.description: 八字，按年柱、月柱、日柱、时柱顺序，用空格隔开。例如：戊寅 己未 己卯 辛未

cards.name: getSolarTimes
usage_rules: bazi 必填，按年柱、月柱、日柱、时柱的顺序提供，四柱之间用空格分隔。
例如：戊寅 己未 己卯 辛未。

cards.description: 获取指定公历日期的黄历信息；未提供日期时默认查询今天。
cards.name: getChineseCalendar
usage_rules: solarDatetime 为可选参数，使用带时区的 ISO 公历时间，例如 2008-03-01T13:00:00+08:00。
省略 solarDatetime 时查询今天。

cards.description: Returns the latest version of a Clojars dependency.
cards.name: get_clojars_latest_version
usage_rules: Provide the dependency as a Clojars name in "group/artifact" format, such as "metosin/reitit".

cards.description: Checks whether a specified version of a Clojars dependency exists.
cards.name: check_clojars_version_exists
usage_rules: Provide the dependency in "group/artifact" format and the version to check.

cards.description: Returns version history for a Clojars dependency, with optional sorting, date filtering, stability filtering, and pagination.

descending.description: Reverse the selected sort order; defaults to the tool's existing latest-first behavior

from_date.description: Filter versions released on or after this date (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD)

include_latest_first.description: Whether to return versions in newest-to-oldest order (default: true)

limit.description: Number of versions to return (default: 15, max: 100)

offset.description: Number of versions to skip before applying limit (for pagination, default: 0)

sort_by.description: Sort results by 'version' (default) or 'release_date' when available

stable_only.description: Whether to exclude pre-release versions such as alpha, beta, rc, snapshot, and milestone releases (default: false)

to_date.description: Filter versions released on or before this date (ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD)

cards.name: get_clojars_history
usage_rules: Provide the dependency in "group/artifact" format.
Use from_date and to_date in YYYY-MM-DD format to include versions released on or after or on or before the respective date.
sort_by may be "version" or "release_date"; release-date sorting is available when release dates are available.
Results default to newest-to-oldest order; include_latest_first controls that ordering, and descending reverses the selected sort order.
Set stable_only to true to exclude prereleases such as alpha, beta, rc, snapshot, and milestone releases; it defaults to false.
limit defaults to 15 and must be between 1 and 100. offset defaults to 0 and must be nonnegative.

cards.description: Returns metadata for a Clojars artifact, including its description, homepage, licenses, and maintainers.
cards.name: get_clojars_artifact_info
usage_rules: Provide the dependency as a Clojars name in "group/artifact" format, such as "metosin/reitit".

cards.description: List all variables currently defined in the math context.
cards.name: list_variables

cards.description: Validate a mathematical expression against the supported grammar, with options for variable references, balanced delimiters, nesting depth, detail, and AST output.

allow_variables.description: Explicitly specify whether variable references are allowed during validation

check_balanced.description: If true, perform additional validation to ensure all brackets and parentheses are properly balanced

detailed.description: If true, return a more detailed validation result when supported

max_depth.description: Maximum allowed nesting depth for expressions (e.g., nested parentheses or function calls). If specified, validation fails if depth exceeds this limit

show_ast.description: If true, include the abstract syntax tree (AST) structure in the validation result

cards.name: validate_syntax
usage_rules: Provide the expression and explicitly set allow_variables to true or false.
Use check_balanced to request additional bracket and parenthesis balance checking; it defaults to true.
Set max_depth to an integer from 1 through 100 to limit nesting; omit it for no specified limit.
detailed and show_ast default to false and may be enabled when the corresponding validation result is wanted.

cards.description: Clear all variables currently defined in the math context.
cards.name: clear_variables
usage_rules: This operation clears all defined variables, not just a selected variable.

cards.description: Evaluate an array of mathematical expressions in one batch and report the results.

expressions.description: Array of mathematical expressions to evaluate

stop_on_error.description: If true, stop processing on first error; if false, continue and report all results

cards.name: batch_evaluate
usage_rules: Provide the expressions array; each item must be a string.
stop_on_error defaults to false, so processing continues and reports all results; set it to true to stop at the first error.

cards.description: Retrieve the value of a named variable from the math context.
cards.name: get_variable
usage_rules: Provide the variable name to retrieve.

cards.description: Evaluate a mathematical expression and store its value under a variable name in the math context.

expression.description: Mathematical expression to evaluate and store

cards.name: set_variable
usage_rules: Provide both the variable name and the expression to evaluate and store.

cards.description: Evaluate a mathematical expression using strict grammar validation, or validate its syntax without evaluating it.

validate_only.description: If true, only validate syntax without evaluation

cards.name: evaluate
usage_rules: Provide an expression.
validate_only defaults to false; set it to true to validate syntax without evaluation.

cards.description: 将给定速度数值从一种单位转换为另一种单位。支持 mps（米/秒）、kmh（千米/小时）、mph（英里/小时）、fps（英尺/秒）和 knot（节）。
cards.name: speed_conversion
usage_rules: 提供数值以及 from_unit 和 to_unit；两个单位必须使用支持的枚举值。
value 可以是任意数值；负数也可用于表示带方向的速度。

cards.description: 根据实部和虚部计算复数的共轭，结果对应 real − imag·i。
cards.name: complex_conjugate
usage_rules: real 和 imag 都是必填数值。

cards.description: 将给定时间数值从一种单位转换为另一种单位。支持 ms、second、minute、hour、day、week、month 和 year。
cards.name: time_conversion
usage_rules: 提供数值以及 from_unit 和 to_unit；单位必须使用支持的枚举值。
请注意，month 和 year 的时长可能依赖工具采用的换算约定；不要将其视为特定日历月份或年份。

cards.description: 将大于 1 的正整数分解为素因数的乘积。
cards.name: primeFactorization
usage_rules: n 必须是整数且至少为 2。

cards.description: 计算输入值的反正切，并以弧度返回结果。
cards.name: atan
usage_rules: value 是必填数值；没有额外的输入范围限制。

cards.description: 计算输入值的反正弦，并以弧度返回结果。
cards.name: asin
usage_rules: value 必须在 -1 到 1 的闭区间内，才能得到实数结果。

cards.description: 计算从 n 个元素中选择 r 个元素的组合数 C(n,r)，选择时不考虑顺序。
cards.name: combination
usage_rules: n 和 r 都必须是非负整数。
组合数要求 r 不大于 n；请确保满足此条件。

cards.description: 计算数字数组中所有元素的乘积。
cards.name: product
usage_rules: numbers 是必填数组，数组元素必须都是数值。

cards.description: 计算 a 除以 b 的余数。
cards.name: modulo
usage_rules: a 和 b 都是必填数值。
b 不得为 0。

cards.description: 计算 matrix_a 减去 matrix_b 的矩阵差。
cards.name: matrix_subtract
usage_rules: 两个参数都必须是由数值行组成的二维数组。
两个矩阵必须具有相同的行数，且对应行的列数相同，才能逐元素相减。

cards.description: 根据圆锥体的底面半径和高度计算其体积及表面积。

height.description: 高度

cards.name: cone_calculation
usage_rules: radius 和 height 都是必填正数，且必须大于 0。

cards.description: 计算从 n 个元素中选择 r 个元素的排列数 P(n,r)，选择时考虑顺序。
cards.name: permutation
usage_rules: n 和 r 都必须是非负整数。
排列数要求 r 不大于 n；请确保满足此条件。

cards.description: 计算单位贡献毛益、贡献毛益率、盈亏平衡销量和销售额，以及达到目标利润所需的销量，用于成本结构与经营决策分析。

target_profit.description: 目标利润（默认0，表示仅计算盈亏平衡点）

cards.name: break_even_analysis
usage_rules: 必须提供固定成本总额、单位售价和单位变动成本；三者均为非负数，但单位售价必须大于0。
目标利润可选，默认为0，且必须为非负数；设为0表示计算盈亏平衡点。
若要计算有限的盈亏平衡或目标利润销量，单位售价应大于单位变动成本。

cards.description: 计算输入数值的立方根。
cards.name: cbrt
usage_rules: 必须提供数值参数 a；负数、零和正数均可。

cards.description: 计算输入方阵的逆矩阵。
cards.name: matrix_inverse
usage_rules: 必须提供由数值构成的二维数组。
输入应为行数与列数相同的方阵，且矩阵必须可逆。

cards.description: 计算输入值以10为底的对数。
cards.name: log10
usage_rules: 必须提供数值参数 value，且其值必须大于0。

cards.description: 计算输入值以指定底数为底的对数。

base.description: 底数（必须大于0且不等于1）

cards.name: log
usage_rules: 必须提供 value 和 base 两个数值参数。
value 必须大于0；base 必须大于0且不能等于1。

cards.description: 计算 a 的 b 次方。
cards.name: power
usage_rules: 必须提供数值参数 a（底数）和 b（指数）。

cards.description: 根据圆柱体的底面半径和高度，计算其体积与表面积。

height.description: 高度

cards.name: cylinder_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 radius 和 height，二者均须为大于0的数值。

cards.description: 计算输入值的反双曲正切值。
cards.name: atanh
usage_rules: 必须提供数值参数 value。
为获得实数结果，value 必须严格大于-1且严格小于1。

cards.description: 计算斐波那契数列中从0开始编号的第 n 项。
cards.name: fibonacci
usage_rules: 必须提供整数参数 n，且 n 必须大于或等于0。

cards.description: 计算数值数组的中位数。
cards.name: median
usage_rules: 必须提供由数值构成的 numbers 数组。
数组应至少包含一个数值，才能计算中位数。

cards.description: 计算欧拉函数 φ(n)，即小于等于 n 且与 n 互质的正整数个数。
cards.name: eulerPhi
usage_rules: 必须提供整数参数 n，且 n 必须大于或等于1。

cards.description: 生成斐波那契数列的前 n 项。
cards.name: fibonacciSequence
usage_rules: 必须提供整数参数 n，范围为1至100（含两端）。

cards.description: 将温度值在摄氏度（celsius）、华氏度（fahrenheit）和开尔文（kelvin）之间转换。
cards.name: temperature_conversion
usage_rules: 提供 value、from_unit 和 to_unit；单位名称必须使用 schema 中的小写枚举值。
value 可为任意数字；转换结果的单位由 to_unit 指定。

cards.description: 计算数字数组中出现频率最高的值，即众数。
cards.name: mode
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素须为数字。
若要计算有意义的众数，请提供非空数组；schema 未规定多个值并列最高频时的处理方式。

cards.description: 计算数字数组中所有元素的总和。
cards.name: sum
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素须为数字。

cards.description: 计算输入数值的反双曲正弦（asinh）。
cards.name: asinh
usage_rules: 提供一个数字作为 value。

cards.description: 根据以弧度表示的角度计算余割值，即 1/sin(angle)。
cards.name: csc
usage_rules: 提供以弧度表示的 angle，而不是角度制数值。
当 sin(angle) 为零时，余割无定义；避免使用这些输入。

cards.description: 根据贷款本金、年利率、贷款年限和还款频率计算等额本息贷款的每期还款金额；可选提供额外还款及简要还款进度摘要。

extra_payment.description: 每期额外还款金额（默认0）

include_schedule.description: 是否包含简要还款进度摘要

payment_frequency.description: 每年还款次数（默认12，12=按月，4=按季，1=按年）

cards.name: loan_payment
usage_rules: loan_amount、annual_rate 和 years 为必填项，且都必须大于零；annual_rate 使用小数形式，例如 5% 填 0.05。
payment_frequency 为每年还款次数，须为大于零的整数；默认值为 12，可用 4 表示按季、1 表示按年。
extra_payment 为每期额外还款额，须不小于零，默认值为 0。
include_schedule 控制是否包含简要还款进度摘要，默认值为 false。

cards.description: 根据边数和边长计算正多边形的面积与周长。
cards.name: regular_polygon
usage_rules: sides 必须是至少为 3 的整数。
side_length 必须大于零。

cards.description: 将体积数值在毫升、升、立方米、立方厘米、立方英寸、立方英尺、美制加仑、英制加仑、夸脱和品脱之间转换。
cards.name: volume_conversion
usage_rules: 提供 value、from_unit 和 to_unit；单位必须使用 schema 中的枚举值：ml、l、m3、cm3、in3、ft3、gallon_us、gallon_uk、quart 或 pint。
value 可为任意数字，转换目标单位由 to_unit 指定。

cards.description: 找出数字数组中的最小值。
cards.name: min
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素须为数字。
请提供非空数组，以确保存在可返回的最小值。

cards.description: 计算两个数字 a 和 b 的乘积。
cards.name: multiply
usage_rules: a 和 b 均为必填数字。

cards.description: 计算普通年金的未来值，使用每期支付金额、支付期数和每期利率。
cards.name: future_value_annuity
usage_rules: payment 和 interest_rate 必须大于零；interest_rate 使用小数形式。
periods 必须是大于零的整数。
按普通年金提供参数，即每期支付金额对应各期定期支付。

cards.description: 列出指定正整数的所有因子。
cards.name: divisorList
usage_rules: n 必须是 1 到 10000（含端点）之间的整数。

cards.description: 计算整数数组中两个或多个整数的最大公约数。
cards.name: gcd
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers，且为至少包含两个整数的数组；不接受非整数元素。

cards.description: 计算两个矩阵的乘积。
cards.name: matrix_multiply
usage_rules: 必须提供 matrix_a 和 matrix_b，均以二维数组表示，元素为数字。
相乘时 matrix_a 的列数必须等于 matrix_b 的行数；数组的行列尺寸应能构成有效矩阵。

cards.description: 根据椭圆的长半轴和短半轴计算面积与周长的近似值。
cards.name: ellipse_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 semi_major_axis 和 semi_minor_axis，且二者均须为大于 0 的数字。

cards.description: 将以度为单位的角度转换为弧度。
cards.name: degToRad
usage_rules: 必须提供 degrees，且其值为数字；输入单位为度。

cards.description: 计算角度的正割值，即 1/cos(angle)。
cards.name: sec
usage_rules: 必须提供 angle，且其值为数字；角度单位为弧度。
当 cos(angle) 为 0 时正割无定义，应避免此类输入。

cards.description: 计算输入值的双曲余弦。
cards.name: cosh
usage_rules: 必须提供 value，且其值为数字。

cards.description: 使用中心差分法近似计算指定函数在给定点的导数。
cards.name: numerical_derivative
usage_rules: 必须提供 function_type、coefficients 和 point；function_type 仅可为 polynomial、exponential、trigonometric 或 logarithmic。
coefficients 必须是数字数组；其具体排列应符合所选函数类型所需的系数或参数约定。
step_size 可选，必须为大于 0 的数字；未提供时默认使用 0.0001。

cards.description: 计算投资项目的内部收益率（IRR）。
cards.name: internal_rate_of_return
usage_rules: 必须提供大于 0 的 initial_investment，以及由数字组成的 cash_flows 数组。
initial_guess、max_iterations 和 tolerance 均可选；默认值分别为 0.1、100 和 1e-6。
如指定 max_iterations，须为大于 0 的整数；如指定 tolerance，须为大于 0 的数字。

cards.description: 根据两个复数的实部和虚部计算它们的乘积。
cards.name: complex_multiply
usage_rules: 必须提供 a_real、a_imag、b_real 和 b_imag，四项均须为数字；分别表示两个复数的实部与虚部。

cards.description: 判断给定正整数是否为素数。
cards.name: isPrime
usage_rules: 必须提供 n，且为大于或等于 1 的整数；1 不是素数。

cards.description: 根据三条边的长度计算三角形的面积、周长等属性。
cards.name: triangle_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 side_a、side_b 和 side_c，且每项均为大于 0 的数字。
这些边长还须满足三角形两边之和大于第三边，才能构成三角形。

cards.description: 计算数字的平方根。
cards.name: sqrt
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 a；若要求实数平方根，a 应大于或等于 0。

cards.description: 计算输入值的反双曲余弦（arcosh）。
cards.name: acosh
usage_rules: 提供必需的数值参数 value；其值必须大于或等于 1。

cards.description: 计算弧度角的余切值，即 1/tan(angle)。
cards.name: cot
usage_rules: 提供必需的数值参数 angle，单位为弧度。
余切在 tan(angle)=0 时无定义；避开这些输入。

cards.description: 逐元素计算两个二维数值矩阵的和。
cards.name: matrix_add
usage_rules: 提供必需的二维数值数组 matrix_a 和 matrix_b。
两个矩阵应具有相同的行数和每行列数，才能逐元素相加。

cards.description: 计算按期末支付的普通年金现值。
cards.name: present_value_annuity
usage_rules: 提供必需的 payment、periods 和 interest_rate。
payment 和 interest_rate 必须为正数；periods 必须为正整数。
interest_rate 使用每期利率的小数形式，而不是百分数形式。

cards.description: 计算弧度角的正切值。
cards.name: tan
usage_rules: 提供必需的数值参数 angle，单位为弧度。
在 cos(angle)=0 处正切无定义；避开这些输入。

cards.description: 计算弧度角的正弦值。
cards.name: sin
usage_rules: 提供必需的数值参数 angle，单位为弧度。

cards.description: 计算二项式系数，即从 n 个元素中选取 k 个的组合数。
cards.name: binomialCoefficient
usage_rules: 提供必需的非负整数 n 和 k。
组合数通常要求 k 不大于 n。

cards.description: 使用拉格朗日多项式插值，根据已知坐标点计算指定 x 位置的函数值。
cards.name: lagrange_interpolation
usage_rules: 提供数值数组 x_points、y_points，以及数值 interpolation_point。
x_points 与 y_points 应包含相同数量的点，且 x_points 中的值应互不相同。

cards.description: 计算 a 的 n 次方根。
cards.name: nthRoot
usage_rules: 提供数值参数 a 和 n。
n 不能为零；若要求实数结果，负数 a 只能取奇数次根。

cards.description: 将两个复数相加，并分别使用实部和虚部表示输入。
cards.name: complex_add
usage_rules: 提供必需的数值参数 a_real、a_imag、b_real 和 b_imag。
a_real 与 a_imag 分别是第一个复数的实部和虚部；b_real 与 b_imag 分别是第二个复数的实部和虚部。

cards.description: 计算弧度角的余弦值。
cards.name: cos
usage_rules: 提供必需的数值参数 angle，单位为弧度。

cards.description: 将两个数值相加。
cards.name: add
usage_rules: 提供必需的数值参数 a 和 b。

cards.description: 计算二维数值矩阵的转置，将行与列互换。
cards.name: matrix_transpose
usage_rules: 必须提供 matrix，格式为二维数字数组。
为得到标准矩阵转置，输入应为矩形矩阵；工具定义未声明对不规则行长度的处理方式。

cards.description: 判断正整数是否为完全数，即是否等于其所有真因子之和。
cards.name: isPerfectNumber
usage_rules: 必须提供 n，且 n 为大于或等于 1 的整数。

cards.description: 计算正整数 n 的正因子个数。
cards.name: divisorCount
usage_rules: 必须提供 n，且 n 为大于或等于 1 的整数。

cards.description: 计算两个或多个整数的最小公倍数。
cards.name: lcm
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，且至少包含两个整数。
输入定义未限制整数的正负或是否为零；如有零或负数，结果遵循工具的实现约定。

cards.description: 计算方阵的迹，即主对角线元素之和。
cards.name: matrix_trace
usage_rules: 必须提供 matrix，格式为二维数字数组。
输入应为方阵；模式未强制行列数相等。

cards.description: 计算第 n 个贝尔数，即 n 个元素的集合划分数。
cards.name: bellNumber
usage_rules: 必须提供整数 n，范围为 0 到 15（含边界）。

cards.description: 计算第 n 个卡塔兰数。
cards.name: catalan
usage_rules: 必须提供整数 n，范围为 0 到 35（含边界）。

cards.description: 根据上底、下底和高计算梯形面积。

height.description: 高

cards.name: trapezoid_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 top_base、bottom_base 和 height，三者均须为大于 0 的数值。

cards.description: 将由实部和虚部指定的复数转换为极坐标形式 r∠θ。
cards.name: complex_polar
usage_rules: 必须提供 real 和 imag，二者均为数值。
工具定义未说明角度 θ 的单位；使用结果时应以工具返回格式为准。

cards.description: 计算数字数组的范围，即最大值减最小值。
cards.name: range
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，元素均须为数值。
输入模式允许空数组，但空数组没有可计算的最大值和最小值；请提供至少一个数值。

cards.description: 计算方阵的行列式。
cards.name: matrix_determinant
usage_rules: 必须提供 matrix，格式为二维数字数组。
输入应为方阵；模式未强制行列数相等。

cards.description: 按指定操作执行百分比计算，包括百分比变化、占比、加价、折扣、求百分比值和反向百分比。

operation.description: 操作类型：percent_change=百分比变化，percent_of_total=占总数百分比，markup=加价，discount=折扣，find_percentage=求百分比值，reverse_percentage=反向百分比

percentage.description: 百分比值（用于加价、折扣、求百分比等操作）

value1.description: 第一个数值（原值、部分值或基数）

value2.description: 第二个数值（新值、总值或可选）

cards.name: percentage_calculator
usage_rules: 必须提供 operation 和数值 value1。operation 只能是 percent_change、percent_of_total、markup、discount、find_percentage 或 reverse_percentage。
按所选操作提供相应参数：percentage 用于加价、折扣或求百分比等；value2 用于需要第二个数值的计算。模式只要求 value1，未强制这些操作相关参数必填。
如提供 percentage，其值须在 0 到 100（含边界）之间。

cards.description: 计算数字数组的算术平均值。
cards.name: mean
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素必须是数字。
若要得到有意义的平均值，请提供至少一个数字。

cards.description: 根据复数的实部和虚部计算其幅角，结果以弧度表示。
cards.name: complex_argument
usage_rules: 必须同时提供 real（实部）和 imag（虚部），两者都必须是数字。

cards.description: 将重量数值从一种支持的单位转换为另一种支持的单位。
cards.name: weight_conversion
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 value，以及 from_unit 和 to_unit。
源单位和目标单位只能是 mg、g、kg、t、oz、lb 或 stone。

cards.description: 计算数字数组的标准差；可选择计算样本标准差，默认计算总体标准差。

sample.description: 是否为样本标准差（默认为总体标准差）

cards.name: stdDev
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素必须是数字。
sample 可选，必须是布尔值；设为 true 表示样本标准差，省略或设为 false 表示总体标准差。

cards.description: 根据债券面值、票面利率、市场利率、到期年限及付息频率计算理论价格。
cards.name: bond_price
usage_rules: 必须提供 face_value、coupon_rate、market_rate 和 years_to_maturity。
face_value、market_rate 和 years_to_maturity 必须大于 0；coupon_rate 必须大于或等于 0。利率以小数形式提供。
payments_per_year 可选，必须是大于 0 的整数；未提供时默认为 1。

cards.description: 根据球体半径计算体积和表面积。
cards.name: sphere_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供大于 0 的 radius。

cards.description: 使用初始投资额、各期现金流和折现率计算投资项目的净现值（NPV）。
cards.name: net_present_value
usage_rules: 必须提供大于 0 的 initial_investment 和 discount_rate；discount_rate 以小数形式提供。
必须提供 cash_flows 数组，数组元素必须是数字。

cards.description: 将面积数值从一种支持的单位转换为另一种支持的单位。
cards.name: area_conversion
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 value，以及 from_unit 和 to_unit。
源单位和目标单位只能是 mm2、cm2、m2、km2、hectare、acre、in2、ft2 或 yard2。

cards.description: 根据长、宽和高计算长方体的体积和表面积。

height.description: 高度

width.description: 宽度

cards.name: cuboid_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 length、width 和 height，且三者都必须大于 0。

cards.description: 根据矩形的长和宽计算面积、周长等属性。

width.description: 宽度

cards.name: rectangle_calculation
usage_rules: 必须提供 length 和 width，且两者都必须大于 0。

cards.description: 根据点的 x、y 坐标计算从 x 轴正方向到该点的角度，结果以弧度表示。
cards.name: atan2
usage_rules: 必须提供数字 x 和 y。

cards.description: 使用梯形法则近似计算指定函数在给定区间上的定积分。
cards.name: numerical_integration
usage_rules: 必须提供 function_type、coefficients、lower_bound 和 upper_bound。
function_type 只能是 polynomial、exponential、trigonometric 或 logarithmic；coefficients 必须是数字数组。
intervals 可选，必须是 1 到 10000 之间的整数；未提供时默认为 1000。
系数的含义取决于所选函数类型；请按该类型所需的参数提供。

cards.description: 返回数字数组中的最大值。
cards.name: max
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素必须为数字。
请传入非空数组；空数组没有可定义的最大值。

cards.description: 计算输入值的双曲正切值。
cards.name: tanh
usage_rules: 必须提供数值参数 value。

cards.description: 计算两个复数相除的结果。
cards.name: complex_divide
usage_rules: 必须提供被除数的实部 a_real、虚部 a_imag，以及除数的实部 b_real、虚部 b_imag；所有参数均为数字。
除数不能为零复数，即 b_real 和 b_imag 不能同时为 0。

cards.description: 使用二分法，在指定区间内求解所选函数的根。
cards.name: bisection_method
usage_rules: 必须提供 function_type、coefficients、left_bound 和 right_bound；function_type 仅支持 polynomial、exponential、trigonometric 或 logarithmic。
coefficients 必须是数字数组；其内容应与所选函数类型及目标函数相符。
区间端点应满足 left_bound < right_bound，并应夹住根（对于连续函数，端点函数值通常需要异号或至少一端为零），以便二分法适用。
可选 max_iterations 必须为正整数，默认值为 100；可选 tolerance 必须为正数，默认值为 1e-6。

cards.description: 计算输入值的自然对数（以 e 为底）。
cards.name: ln
usage_rules: 必须提供数值参数 value。
value 必须大于 0。

cards.description: 计算 a 减去 b 的结果。
cards.name: subtract
usage_rules: 必须提供数字参数 a（被减数）和 b（减数）。

cards.description: 计算数字 a 的绝对值。
cards.name: abs
usage_rules: 必须提供数字参数 a。

cards.description: 使用牛顿法求解所选函数的根。
cards.name: newton_method
usage_rules: 必须提供 function_type、coefficients 和 initial_guess；function_type 仅支持 polynomial、exponential、trigonometric 或 logarithmic。
coefficients 必须是数字数组；其内容应与所选函数类型及目标函数相符。
initial_guess 应为数字，并宜选择靠近目标根且函数在附近可微的起始点；牛顿法可能不收敛。
可选 max_iterations 必须为正整数，默认值为 100；可选 tolerance 必须为正数，默认值为 1e-6。

cards.description: 计算由实部和虚部组成的复数的模长（绝对值）。
cards.name: complex_magnitude
usage_rules: 必须提供数字参数 real（实部）和 imag（虚部）。

cards.description: 根据本金、年利率、投资期数和复利频率计算复利投资的未来价值。

annual_rate.description: 年利率（小数形式，如0.05表示5%）

compounding_frequency.description: 每年复利次数（1=年复利，4=季复利，12=月复利）

cards.name: compound_interest
usage_rules: 必须提供 principal、annual_rate 和 periods；principal 与 periods 必须大于 0。
annual_rate 必须在 0 到 1 之间（含边界），以小数形式表示，例如 0.05 表示 5%。
可选 compounding_frequency 必须为正整数，表示每年复利次数；默认值为 1。

cards.description: 计算数字数组的方差。

sample.description: 是否为样本方差（默认为总体方差）

cards.name: variance
usage_rules: 必须提供 numbers 数组，数组元素必须为数字。
可选 sample 用于指定是否计算样本方差；未提供时按总体方差计算。
计算样本方差时，数组至少需要包含两个数字；计算总体方差时，数组至少需要包含一个数字。

cards.description: 计算输入值的反余弦，结果以弧度表示。
cards.name: acos
usage_rules: 必须提供数值参数 value。
value 必须在 -1 到 1 之间（含边界）。

cards.description: 计算 a 除以 b 的结果。
cards.name: divide
usage_rules: 必须提供数值参数 a（被除数）和 b（除数），不能附加其他参数。
b 应为非零值，避免除以零。

cards.description: 计算非负整数 n 的阶乘。
cards.name: factorial
usage_rules: 必须提供整数参数 n，且 n 不得小于 0。
不能附加其他参数。

cards.description: 计算两个复数的差，即 (a_real + a_imag·i) − (b_real + b_imag·i)。
cards.name: complex_subtract

cards.description: Runs a process on the Darwin machine. Set mode to "shell" and provide command_line for a shell command, or set mode to "executable" and provide argv, where argv[0] is the executable. A non-empty cwd and mode are required. Supports optional stdin, environment overrides, dry-run explanation, output capture controls, timeout and timeout signal, and a platform-dependent memory limit.

argv.description: Executable and arguments. argv[0] is the executable. Required when mode='executable'. Forbidden when mode='shell'.

capture_output.description: Optional output capture mode: 'full' (default, capture all), 'truncated' (limit to 10KB per stream), or 'none' (discard output).

command_line.description: Shell command line. Required when mode='shell'. Forbidden when mode='executable'.

cwd.description: Working directory. Required and must be a non-empty string.

dry_run.description: Optional explain what would run, defaults to False.

env.description: Optional environment variables as key-value pairs, merged with current process environment.

kill_signal.description: Optional signal to send on timeout: 'SIGTERM' (default), 'SIGKILL', or 'SIGINT'.

max_output_bytes.description: Optional maximum bytes to capture from stdout/stderr combined, overrides capture_output truncation behavior

memory_limit_mb.description: Optional memory limit in megabytes for the spawned process, enforcement is platform-dependent

mode.description: What are you running, two choices: 'shell' or 'executable' (required, no default)

stdin.description: Optional text written to STDIN (written fully, then closed). Useful for heredoc-style input or file contents.

timeout_ms.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds, must be an integer between 1 and 300000, defaults to 30,000ms

cards.name: run_process
usage_rules: Choose exactly one execution mode: for shell mode, provide command_line and do not provide argv; for executable mode, provide a non-empty argv array and do not provide command_line.
Always provide a non-empty cwd.
Use env for string-to-string environment overrides; these are merged with the current process environment.
stdin, if provided, is written fully to the process and then closed.
timeout_ms must be 1–300000 milliseconds; it defaults to 30000. kill_signal may be SIGTERM, SIGKILL, or SIGINT and defaults to SIGTERM.

capture_output may be full (default), truncated (up to 10 KB per stream), or none. max_output_bytes, when provided, limits combined stdout and stderr capture and overrides capture_output truncation behavior; it must be 1–104857600 bytes.
memory_limit_mb, if provided, must be 1–16384; enforcement depends on the platform.
Set dry_run to true to explain what would run without running it.

currentState.description: 當前 Agent 主要該執行的內容，例如使用網路工具搜尋某些關鍵字或分析特定程式碼，研究完畢後請呼叫 research_mode 來記錄狀態並與之前的`previousState`整合，這將幫助你更好的保存與執行研究內容

dependencies.description: 任務的新依賴關係（選填）

lineEnd.description: 相關代碼區塊的結束行（選填）

lineStart.description: 相關代碼區塊的起始行（選填）

path.description: 文件路徑，可以是相對於項目根目錄的路徑或絕對路徑

type.description: 文件與任務的關係類型 (TO_MODIFY, REFERENCE, CREATE, DEPENDENCY, OTHER)

taskId.description: 待更新任務的唯一標識符，必須是系統中存在且未完成的任務ID

verificationCriteria.description: 任務的新驗證標準（選填）

cards.name: update_task

For relatedFiles, each entry requires a non-empty path and a type from TO_MODIFY, REFERENCE, CREATE, DEPENDENCY, or OTHER; description and positive line numbers are optional.

cards.description: Retrieves instructional guidance for a specified task. It guides the caller through completing the work but does not perform the task itself.

taskId.description: 待執行任務的唯一標識符，必須是系統中存在的有效任務ID

cards.name: execute_task
usage_rules: Provide the task's UUID v4 as taskId.
Follow the returned steps and feedback to perform the implementation; calling this tool alone does not complete the task.

cards.description: Analyzes task requirements and the codebase to assess feasibility, risks, and an implementation approach. Any code-level proposal should be high-level pseudocode rather than complete code.

initialConcept.description: 最少50個字符的初步解答構想，包含技術方案、架構設計和實施策略，如果需要提供程式碼請使用 pseudocode 格式且僅提供高級邏輯流程和關鍵步驟避免完整代碼

previousAnalysis.description: 前次迭代的分析結果，用於持續改進方案（僅在重新分析時需提供）

summary.description: 結構化的任務摘要，包含任務目標、範圍與關鍵技術挑戰，最少10個字符

cards.name: analyze_task

Include the task goal, scope, technical challenges, proposed approach, architecture, and implementation strategy in the summary and initial concept as appropriate.
Use previousAnalysis when continuing or revising an earlier analysis; it is optional.

cards.description: Evaluates a task against its verification criteria and records a score and summary. A score of 80 or higher automatically completes the task.

summary.description: 當分數高於或等於 80分時代表任務完成摘要，簡潔描述實施結果和重要決策，當分數低於 80分時代表缺失或需要修正的部分說明，最少30個字

taskId.description: 待驗證任務的唯一標識符，必須是系統中存在的有效任務ID

Assess requirements compliance, technical quality, integration compatibility, and performance/scalability using the task's verification criteria.

cards.description: Provides step-by-step guidance for planning tasks or complex features, optionally using existing tasks as a planning reference.

existingTasksReference.description: 是否參考現有任務作為規劃基礎，用於任務調整和延續性規劃

requirements.description: 任務的特定技術要求、業務約束條件或品質標準（選填）

Include technical requirements, constraints, or quality standards in requirements when applicable.
Do not rely on assumptions or guesses; gather factual information using available tools before planning.

cards.description: Decompose a complex task into independent, verifiable subtasks, with priorities and dependencies. Provide the task list as a string in tasksRaw, and choose an updateMode. An optional globalAnalysisResult can supply analysis that applies across all tasks.

tasksRaw.description: 結構化的任務清單，每個任務應保持原子性且有明確的完成標準，避免過於簡單的任務，簡單修改可與其他任務整合，避免任務過多，範例：[{name: '簡潔明確的任務名稱，應能清晰表達任務目的', description: '詳細的任務描述，包含實施要點、技術細節和驗收標準', implementationGuide: '此特定任務的具體實現方法和步驟，請參考之前的分析結果提供精簡pseudocode', notes: '補充說明、特殊處理要求或實施建議（選填）', dependencies: ['此任務依賴的前置任務完整名稱'], relatedFiles: [{path: '文件路徑', type: '文件類型 (TO_MODIFY: 待修改, REFERENCE: 參考資料, CREATE: 待建立, DEPENDENCY: 依賴文件, OTHER: 其他)', description: '文件描述', lineStart: 1, lineEnd: 100}], verificationCriteria: '此特定任務的驗證標準和檢驗方法'}, {name: '任務2', description: '任務2描述', implementationGuide: '任務2實現方法', notes: '補充說明、特殊處理要求或實施建議（選填）', dependencies: ['任務1'], relatedFiles: [{path: '文件路徑', type: '文件類型 (TO_MODIFY: 待修改, REFERENCE: 參考資料, CREATE: 待建立, DEPENDENCY: 依賴文件, OTHER: 其他)', description: '文件描述', lineStart: 1, lineEnd: 100}], verificationCriteria: '此特定任務的驗證標準和檢驗方法'}]

updateMode.description:
任務更新模式選擇：'append'(保留所有現有任務並添加新任務)、'overwrite'(清除所有未完成任務並完全替換，保留已完成任務)、'selective'(智能更新：根據任務名稱匹配更新現有任務，保留不在列表中的任務，推薦用於任務微調)、'clearAllTasks'(清除所有任務並創建備份)。
預設為'clearAllTasks'模式，只有用戶要求變更或修改計劃內容才使用其他模式

cards.name: split_tasks
usage_rules: Provide both required fields: tasksRaw (a string containing the structured task list) and updateMode (one of append, overwrite, selective, or clearAllTasks). Supply globalAnalysisResult only when there is shared analysis to include.
Make each subtask independently completable and verifiable by one developer in about 1–2 working days (8–16 hours); avoid combining frontend, backend, and database work in one subtask.
Limit a batch to 10 subtasks, preferably fewer; if more are needed, use prioritized batches of 6–8. Keep each split to 5,000 characters or fewer and the task tree to no more than three levels.

Give tasks clear names, implementation details, and acceptance or verification criteria. Include dependencies by the full names of prerequisite tasks, and specify relevant files and their roles where useful.

For interface-related work, specify consistent definitions for names, parameters, return values, data types, required or optional items, errors, conventions, and examples. Use only high-level pseudocode where implementation guidance is needed; do not provide complete source code.

Use append to retain unfinished tasks and add tasks; overwrite to replace unfinished tasks while retaining completed ones; selective to update tasks matched by name while retaining unmatched tasks; use clearAllTasks to clear the list and create a backup. Use clearAllTasks for an unrelated new task set. Although clearAllTasks is described as the default, updateMode is required and must be supplied explicitly.
Ensure the content encoded in tasksRaw is valid JSON where JSON is used: do not include comments and escape special characters correctly.

cards.description: Critically review a technical analysis for completeness, best-practice alignment, and opportunities to improve or optimize the proposed solution. Provide a structured task summary and the full analysis.

analysis.description: 完整詳盡的技術分析結果，包括所有技術細節、依賴組件和實施方案，如果需要提供程式碼請使用 pseudocode 格式且僅提供高級邏輯流程和關鍵步驟避免完整代碼

summary.description: 結構化的任務摘要，保持與分析階段一致以確保連續性

cards.name: reflect_task

Keep the summary consistent with the analysis and the preceding analysis stage.
If code-level guidance is needed, use pseudocode to describe only the high-level logic and key steps; do not provide complete code.

cards.description: Search tasks within a source by status, task ID, or text. Status and text-term filters are optional; results may be capped with a limit.

Source ID from task_setup() response
- Defaults to most recent in the workspace if not provided

- If you don't have it, ask the user for a file path and call task_setup()

Use the returned source_id in subsequent task-tool calls when possible.
Use task tools when the user mentions new or updated tasks.

0-based index to place the tasks. e.g.:
- 0 for "Do this next"
- Omit to place at the end ("Do this later")

Source ID from task_setup() response
- Defaults to most recent in the workspace if not provided
- Try to always provide it!
- If you don't have it, ask the user for a file path and call task_setup()

anyOf.description:

- "Reminders" instructions for you (the AI) to be constantly reminded of

status.description:

The tool returns a complete summary, so do not call tasks_summary immediately afterward.

cards.description: Retrieve task counts by status and identify the current work-in-progress task or tasks.

return_markdown_embed.description: Optional. Whether to include markdown_embed in successful responses. Defaults to true.

skip_fetch_check.description: Optional. Whether to skip the diagram URL fetch check after generation. Defaults to false.

validate_syntax.description: Optional. Whether to validate PlantUML syntax before generating the diagram. Defaults to true.

cards.name: generate_plantuml_diagram
usage_rules: Provide PlantUML source in the required plantuml_code field.

Use output_mode to select full, url_only, or markdown_only response content. return_markdown_embed controls whether a Markdown embed is included in successful responses when applicable.

Use output_path to save locally; parent directories are created automatically. Paths are restricted to the current working directory unless PLANTUML_ALLOWED_DIRS permits other locations, and only .svg and .png extensions are allowed.
Use diagram_name as the base filename when output_path is omitted or directory-like; the selected format extension is applied automatically.
plantuml_server_url overrides the configured server for this request. fetch_timeout_ms sets the request timeout, and skip_fetch_check controls the post-generation URL fetch check.
